listing.summary: Help with easily managing fleets by providing tools to copy, add, and save; fleets, officers, ships, variants, and more.
listing.aiSummary: Adds tools to copy, paste, and manage fleets, officers, ships, and variants using hotkeys and custom menus.

description:
FleetBuilder

 


The mod requires LazyLib and MagicLib
LunaLib is optional for mod settings
Help with easily managing fleets by providing tools to copy, add, and save; fleets, officers, ships, variants, and more.

Including but not limited to:
Copy and paste ships and officers to and from your clipboard with simple hotkeys.
A custom autofit menu for the refit screen with unlimited slots that stay between saves.
A clickable filter in the fleet screen that lets you type in keywords to filter for that specific ship you want.
Save Transfers: Save and load; all your ships, officers, cargo, blueprints, relations, player stats, etc. Works even with disabled mods.

This mod is made with the intention to be as non-intrusive as possible. Anything that visibly changes base game behavior is disabled by default and will need to be enabled manually.
As a utility mod, this mod can safely be added/removed mid-save.


CTRL Clicked the ship to copy it, then used CTRL + V to paste another one of it.

See More:
Screenshots

Opened the save transfer dialog with CTRL + I
Click 'Copy Save To Clipboard' to put your save transfer data into your clipboard. Paste it into a file somewhere if you want to keep it.
Later when desired, copy your save transfer data if it is not already, and click "Load Save From Clipboard" to load it in. 


Pasted a fleet


Opened the officer creator dialog with CTRL + O
Creating an officer this way gives a level 0 officer with enough XP to level up completely.
On leveling up that officer you get to pick between every officer skill available. This makes it useful for easily creating specific officer skill sets.
Example Result:




Opened the autofit menu. (Requires enabling it in the lunalib settings)
Click and drag the ship on the right into a slot on the left to save it to that slot. The saved ship loadout will remain across different save files.
Click any slot containing a ship loadout to autofit your ship into it, or as close as possible to it.
Click the X to delete the ship loadout in that slot.


Right clicking HullMods with Cheats enabled.

Hotkeys:

    CTRL Click
Fleet member: Copies clicked member
Officer portrait: Copies clicked officer

    CTRL + C in 
Fleet screen: Copies own fleet
Interaction screen: Copies fleet encounter (hold alt to avoid copying supporting fleets)
Refit Screen: Copies variant
Codex: Copies variant/member

Hold shift when copying if you want to copy a user viewable and editable version in JSON instead of the default behavior of copying a compressed string.

    CTRL + V in 
Refit screen: Add variant in clipboard to the relevant autofit menu.
    The below require Cheats to be enabled. (Type 'cheats' into the console or enable it in the settings) 
Fleet screen: Add the copied fleet/member/variant/officer to your fleet
Campaign map: Spawn fleet in the clipboard into the campaign

Miscellaneous:

Fix Ship Skin Source Mod: Ensures ship skins display their correct originating mod in the codex by resolving the vanilla issue where skins (e.g., Sunder XIV) lack an assigned source mod.

The below need to be enabled in the mod settings (via LunaLib) for them to function

Mothball Recovered Ships: Newly recovered ships will be automatically mothballed

Store Officer in Cargo: When putting ships into storage, officers go along with them. When taking the ships out of storage, the officer remains on the ship.

Fleet Screen Filter: A clickable text box where you input keywords to filter for that specific ship you want.
Hullmod filter: Same as above, but for filtering between hullmods in the refit screen.

Unassign Player: Right click your player officer to unassign them from the fleet and assign them to a non combat command shuttle. The shuttle cannot be sent into battle, and is excluded from your fleet when copying it.

Display Derelict Recovery Early: Shows the ship preview earlier during derelict salvage. Instead of requiring “Consider Special Measures” to view the ship, the preview is available a step earlier when you get the option to salvage it.

Remove Old Intel Updates: Remove codex and simulator unlocks after a specified number of days has passed since they have appeared.


Custom Battles:

If you want to fight two fleets together, it is quite easy.

Option 1:
CTRL + C in your fleet screen to copy your fleet to your clipboard. (consider right clicking to unassign your player officer if you don't want them as an officer)
Paste it to someone else.

Option 2:
Copy the contents of someone else's fleet.
CTRL + V in the campaign to fight against it.

Option 3: (Requires the FleetBuilderCB mod)
Open missions tab, find the Custom Fleet Battle mission.
Copy your desired fleet
Click the button for the desired side you want the fleet on.
Do the same for a fleet on the other side.
Fight!


Known Issues:
Spoiler
Autofit UI:
   Built in Fighters do not account for hull-mod if hull-mod were to change fighter. E.G roider union trackerswap. unless vanilla autofit menu was opened previously.
Feedback is greatly appreciated.
